body:
Track, per item, which ACCOUNT last wrote any of its fields, and surface a
small indicator on the item row — Android: full; web: basic (indicator can
be visually simpler) — but ONLY when the list has 2+ members (single-owner
lists show nothing; no clutter for the common solo case). Gate on
`memberships` count for the list, via the existing
`GET /lists/<id>/members` endpoint (already returns member emails; Android
already calls it — see Api.kt — web does not yet and will need to add a
client-side call).

Design (clarified with user): ONE "last-touched-by" value per item, not
separate creator+editor fields. For a never-edited item this equals the
creator; ANY field write on the item (including e.g. checking/unchecking,
not just editing name/price/etc.) updates it to the writing account. This
is a real scope simplification vs. tracking both — deliberately chosen.

Why this needs a schema change: the sync engine currently tags every field
write with an anonymous per-device `device_id` (the existing `_by`
columns, e.g. `name_by`, `status_by`) — there is no stored link from a
device_id to the account that used it (no "devices" table), so today's
data cannot answer "which account wrote this." Add:

- `items.last_touched_by_account_id TEXT`, `items.last_touched_ts INTEGER
  NOT NULL DEFAULT 0` — item-level (not per-field), updated whenever ANY
  field-level LWW write wins for that item: compare against
  `last_touched_ts` the same way the existing per-field `_ts`/`_by` pairs
  are compared, but keyed by account_id + one timestamp for the whole
  item. This is independent of and does not change the existing granular
  per-field `_by` device_id columns, which keep doing their existing job
  (LWW tie-breaking) unmodified.
- `account_settings.initials TEXT` — nullable. NULL means "derive a
  default from the account's email" (leading 1-2 characters of the
  email's local-part). The account's Settings screen lets the user
  override with any 1-3 characters they choose — Android: full editable
  field; web: at least a basic text input, doesn't need Android's exact
  styling.
- Extend `GET /lists/<id>/members` to also return each member's initials
  (resolved default-or-override) alongside their existing email, so
  clients don't need a second per-account lookup to render the badge.

Migration: two additive ALTER TABLEs with safe defaults. There's no
versioned migration mechanism yet (T-57, open/unclaimed) — don't block on
it; bundle a guarded one-off migration in this ticket (same reasoning as
T-62's notes column).

Wire contract: item sync payloads include `last_touched_by` (the
account_id, resolved against the list's already-fetched member roster —
see the /members extension above — to get email/initials for display;
storing account_id rather than email keeps it referentially tied to the
account even if email display formatting changes later).

Indicator UI: small initials badge (e.g. a ~24dp circle with 1-3 letters)
on each item row; tap/long-press/hover reveals the full email as a
tooltip/accessibility label. Only rendered when the list's member count
is 2+.
title: Item last-touched-by indicator (multi-member lists) + account initials preference
